title: Rollin' Outta Barstow
author: Chris Page
problems: Row 2 "larks start a hey - lefts in center, rights on ends - until larks meet the second time - larks ricochet second time" can't start from where the dancers are: The larks do not meet in the middle 2 times in this hey.
Row 4 "mad robins, larks in front (clockwise around neighbor) [3]" can't start from where the dancers are: With the larks in front this mad robin turns the other way.
The progression after row 8 "star left 4 places" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
